messages:
matt: rolling forward v4.2.0 to prod. canary at 10% -> 100% in progress. deploy-bot flagged a small but consistent error uptick on /v1/embeddings (5xx +5%). holding for decision — pinging @alana @liz.

deploy-bot: CANARY_ALERT: route=/v1/embeddings errors=+5% (5xx), p95 latency=+18% over baseline. canary traffic=10%. auto-rollforward=false.

alana: got it. is this visible only in a single dedicated pool or global?

liz: looks like the spike is concentrated in dedicated-usw2 pool from the telemetry dashboard. hosted traffic unaffected so far.

ben: if it's just usw2 dedicated, i'd prefer partial rollback/pin for that pool rather than global revert. less blast radius.

matt: agree but we need comms for customers on that pool. also want to avoid split-brain model variants. what's the rollback command?

sre-oncall: i can execute. partial rollback via traffic-split is safest. command: 
```
/deploy traffic-split --pool dedicated-usw2 --from v4.2.0 --to v4.1.9 --percent 100 --reason "canary errors"
```
will cut traffic back to v4.1.9 for that pool only. should be quick (<2m).

alana: +1. also pin v4.1.9 for the pool to stop deploybot from retrying the canary. command to pin: 
```
/deploy pin --pool dedicated-usw2 --version v4.1.9 --ttl 24h --note "emergency pin after canary error spike"
```

liz: i'll coordinate with CS to notify impacted customers in usw2. draft message below, please thumbs up or edit: 
"Hi — during a routine rollout we observed an increase in errors for requests routed to your us-west-2 dedicated pool. We've reverted the pool to v4.1.9 while we investigate. No data loss is expected. We'll follow up with a postmortem and timeline for safe re-roll. — Liz / Customer Success"

ben: LGTM. include a link to the incident page and contact escalation phone.

matt: deployment ops: who owns the post-rollback validation checks? i can run the smoke set if someone runs the rollback.

sre-oncall: i'm on it. running the traffic-split now. will post status.

deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic-split initiated by sre-oncall for pool=dedicated-usw2 from=v4.2.0 to=v4.1.9. request_id=rbk-2605004321.

sre-oncall: traffic-split completed, 100% to v4.1.9. checking metrics.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin applied to pool=dedicated-usw2 version=v4.1.9 ttl=24h by sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: metrics trending back to baseline — errors down to normal, p95 latency back within 5% of baseline. smoke tests green.

matt: thanks. liz, please send the CS note and add a short entry to release-notes: "partial rollback on dedicated-usw2 for v4.2.0 due to canary error spike; reverted to v4.1.9; investigating."

liz: sending now and creating a short incident card. cc @ben for escalation contacts.

alana: we should schedule a focused debug on the v4.2.0 embedding path tomorrow. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

ben: adding to eng-releases board. i'll draft a rollback postmortem template.

matt: closing the thread — thanks everyone. we'll reopen if roll-forward is attempted again before fixes. :thumbsup:
